ITEM.PTXT: Front/rear brake force distribution control achieves an appropriate distribution of braking force to the front and rear wheels according to the vehicle driving conditions, with the aim of fully bringing out the "stopping" performance that is the basic function of the brakes.

As a result, the braking force of the rear wheels can be effectively used according to load changes due to loading conditions and deceleration, reducing the brake pedal effort particularly when loaded and ensuring excellent braking effectiveness.
